provenance.after: if i < a.size then b[i - a.size]! else a[i]!
provenance.before: if i < a.size then a[i]! else b[i - a.size]!

start.code:
let n := a.size + b.size
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (c : Array Int) : Array Int :=
    if i < n then
      let value := if i < a.size then b[i - a.size]! else a[i]!
      loop (i + 1) (c.set! i value)
    else
      c
  loop 0 (Array.mkArray n 0)
